scope: Accept sparse sampled feedback only; not continuous smoothness, touch input, shoreline animation or real phone FPS.

hitFlash.evidence: White player silhouette clearly visible at .1/.2 seconds, normal by .4; hull35→27 and return prompt appear. Cyan circle does not conceal flash.

impactRecognition.evidence: Small orange hit at .1/.2 and much larger textured orange/yellow fireball at1 second distinguish damage scale; sparks/smoke at1.5, no fire2/3.

smokeFading.evidence: Turn produces curved smoke at1.5; older sections thin by2/3. No lasting opaque explosion disk.
smokeFading.weakness: Gray grainy trail competes with dark mottled water; exact fade transitions between sparse samples unknown.

wakeContinuity.evidence: Stern wakes remain attached as carrier exits upper frame and escort crosses below/right.

cameraMotion.evidence: Initial catch-up brings player central; turn and world translation remain coherent in samples.
cameraMotion.weakness: Initial catch-up visible; stills cannot establish jitter-free continuous movement.

controlVisibility.evidence: HUD/action buttons stay legible; heat rises and cools. Ring follows player through deck crossing and turn.
controlVisibility.weakness: Fallback circle is jagged, remains prominent in open water, and does not resolve actual plane/deck overlap. Ship passes under Bomb at3 seconds; touch untested.

regressionsAndLimits: No new sampled motion failure observed.
Shoreline foam absent from this sequence, so its animation/continuity remains unassessed.
Smoke and shadow visibility still compete with ocean texture.
